Package game.items.tools

Class Hoe

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.items.Item
game.items.tools.AbstractEnchantableTool
game.items.tools.Hoe
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Enchantable, HasStaminaCost, TillingTool
public class Hoe extends AbstractEnchantableTool implements TillingTool
A Hoe that the Farmer can carry and use to till dirt (and potentially other tillable ground) into soil.

While enchanted, tilling a tile also tills every tillable tile adjacent to it, then fires the attached Enchantment against every tile the till touched (the original tile is handled by TillAction itself, not here, since this effect only concerns the extra spread).
